items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: And Zutty, they was going to fire Paul Bobbins out of King Arnold's band for Zutty. ... Barney, Bigall, Nick. Nick, I think. I think they had Donnell Howell in the band too with him.

ctx.x: A mercuro. I said, put some of that on and stick them in. Stick them in ice. Freeze them. And I said, and I said, OK. And I said, don't care how bad they're height, force them, play on them. I said, you did them hard. The man, I said, that's all, they might bleed. I said, that's good. And his fingers got hard. Then he started giving the other guy, I thought, man, I can't do it. He said, well, pop, don't we do it? Well, that's all I ever did. And you can hear it, you can hear me. As Nick said, I ain't got but of…
